title: Performance Management System
summary: A centralised platform for running employee performance evaluations through a multi-level organisational workflow. Each level reviews the level below it, and every evaluation moves through an approval chain before it counts.
detail: Built the evaluation and approval workflow end to end — team management, employee evaluation, review, approval, rejection and status tracking.
Implemented the My Team view, with employee search, evaluation-status filtering and status-wise employee counts.
Built the evaluation interfaces covering performance objectives, targets, achievements, ratings, overall scores and feedback.
Implemented the multi-level approval and rejection flows, including reason and comment handling and the status updates that follow from them.
Developed the Enquiry and Notification modules for evaluation disputes and workflow updates.
Integrated the frontend with Flask REST APIs and Supabase PostgreSQL, with role-based access following the organisational hierarchy.

caseStudy.problem: Employee evaluations need to move through several levels of an organisation. Reviewers need to find their team, understand each evaluation’s status and record approvals or rejections with the relevant feedback.
caseStudy.approach: The project brings employee evaluations, team views, approval status, enquiries and notifications into a single platform. My work connected the evaluation and review screens to Flask REST APIs and Supabase PostgreSQL.
architecture: Next.js / React — team views and evaluation screens
Flask REST APIs — evaluation and approval operations

title: BlogApp
summary: A blogging platform with dynamic post management, a Markdown editor that previews as you type, search across published posts, and profile administration.
detail: Built the authentication engine: secure login and session management with role-based access.
Developed the Markdown editor, with live preview, formatting controls and draft saving.
Implemented the full post CRUD lifecycle — creation, inline editing and deletion behind confirmation modals.
Engineered post discovery with real-time text search and detailed post views.
Designed a personalised profile dashboard showing activity metrics and post management controls.

caseStudy.problem: A blogging platform needs to support the complete writing journey: signing in, drafting content, previewing formatting, publishing and finding posts again.
caseStudy.approach: The project combines authentication and role-based access with a Markdown editing experience, post management, search and a personal profile dashboard.
architecture: Next.js / React — editor, posts and profile dashboard

title: CNC Paper Board Cutting Machine
summary: An automated CNC machine that cuts paper board from G-code, driven by an ESP32 coordinating stepper motors, servo motors and optical sensors.
detail: Implemented the LCD operator interface and the servo motor control for machine operation.
Integrated and synchronised the paper feeding mechanism with the cutting process.
Designed the machine's 3D components in Blender.

caseStudy.problem: Automated paper-board cutting requires the material feed and cutting mechanism to operate together, with an interface that lets an operator control the machine.
caseStudy.approach: The machine uses an ESP32 with motors and optical sensors to execute G-code-driven cutting. My work covered the LCD operator interface, servo control, paper-feed synchronisation and 3D component design in Blender.
architecture: Motor drivers, motors and optical sensors — motion and sensing
